title: Trample only works on attack
notes: R1750000: a unit's Trample applies only to the hits of its own attack, its hit on the defender and its Cleave's, so a defender's strike back and the damage a unit's text deals never trample, and an attack on an ally a Redirect re-aimed still tramples into its own hero; a Spell that prints Trample tramples as before (revises R63 and R176). A game with a Trample unit meets it, so the classifier reads it as a rule every game meets.

player.title: Trample only works on attack
changes: Trample sends the excess damage to a hero only when the unit with it is the one attacking.
A unit with Trample that is attacked strikes back for its full attack and no longer damages the hero of the unit that attacked it.
